blocks.orig: A walking safari of 6 to 8 hours through Arusha National Park is said to be unforgettable. Guided by an experienced ranger, you get up close with giraffes, buffalos, zebras, warthogs, and blue monkeys while learning about the park’s unique flora and fauna. You, for example, pass by an impressive waterfall, the Ngurdoto Crater, and Lake Momella. And if you are lucky you will also see flocks of flamingos and the impressive Colobus monkey swinging through the trees.
blocks.html: People say a 6 to 8 hour walking safari through Arusha National Park is one you’ll never forget. With an experienced ranger leading the way, you get close to giraffes, buffalos, zebras, warthogs and blue monkeys and learn about the park’s distinctive flora and fauna. Along the way you pass, for instance, an impressive waterfall, the Ngurdoto Crater and Lake Momella. With some luck you’ll also spot flocks of flamingos and the striking Colobus monkey swinging through the trees.
